title: DataProtectionImpactAssessment
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.dataprotection.DataProtectionImpactAssessment). An approved assessment past its `valid_until` activates nothing, which is the practical meaning of 'expired' even before anyone transitions it. The reviewer must be independent of the controller and the process owner: an assessment signed off by the party that wants the processing is not a review. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
